newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH SPORITELNA SAYS SIGNS 3YR, 200 MLN MARK LOAN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH SPORITELNA SAYS SIGNS 3YR, 200 MLN MARK LOAN.

text.p: Czech savings bank Ceska Sporitelna a.s. on Thursday said it had signed a three-year, 200 million mark revolving loan arranged by Bankgesellschaft Berlin, and an association of 27 Spanish banks.
Sporitelna said the rate of the loan would be 22.5 basis points above either the one-month, three-month or six-month LIBOR rate, depending on each individual loan tranche.
Sportielna Chairman Jaroslav Klapal told a news conference that funds from the loan would be used to help finance the exporting activites of its clients.
He added that the bank would take a 120 million tranche of the loan next week.
Officials said that more than 60 percent of the loan was signed by the Spanish savings banks.
They added that a maximum of 10 tranches could drawn on the loan.
